text:
samir: heads up — rolled the fw egress tighten to us-west an hour ago and new gpu nodes are failing to join. seeing a ton of keystore/kms decrypt errors. audit events for keystore look sparse. anyone digging?
leah: yep same. new nodes stuck in PROVISIONING, kube shows `ContainerStatus: Waiting: CrashLoopBackOff` for keystore-init. logs: `keystore: decrypt failed: AccessDenied`
ajay: which firewall rule did we flip? dns/ip change?
samir: `fw-egress-tighten-us-west` — it enforces default-deny and only allows privatelink endpoints we listed last week. looks like privatelink changed IPs during keystore endpoint rotation.
maria: cloudtrail: keystore:GetSecretValue / kms:Decrypt calls missing from 2023-11-06T22:12:00Z -> 22:18:00Z for the join attempts. that matches the node join window.
leah: quick check: `kubectl get pods -n infra -l app=keystore -o wide` shows keystore pods on new nodes failing to talk to 10.12.45.21 privatelink. traceroute from pod -> 10.12.45.21 stops at nat-gw.
ajay: ugh. privatelink ip moved. we should allow the new range temporarily. suggestion: revert fw rule -> allow keystore privatelink CIDR -> restart joins.
samir: +1 revert first. rolling back now. @deploy-bot can you revert `fw-egress-tighten-us-west`?
deploy-bot: I can do a revert but need a CIDR exception to avoid reintroducing risk. Confirming revert window 10m.
infra-bot: automation note: when fw rules change we trigger a keystore endpoint revalidation job; last success: 3380009000, failed checks observed at 3380012000.
maria: action items: (1) rollback fw tighten to restore gpu joins (short term) (2) add allow for updated privatelink IPs in fw policy (3) backfill cloudtrail/audit for missing calls and tag affected nodes (4) update runbook to include privatelink rotation steps + notify ops.
ajay: cost tradeoff: leaving rollback open uses NAT egress for keystore traffic. estimate ~ $200/day extra for the region until we add allowlist by privatelink. fine for now.
leah: rolled back at 3380012450 — nodes are starting to progress to RUNNING. still seeing some KMS throttling errors but most decrypts succeed now.
samir: great. maria — can you start the audit backfill and open an incident ticket with start_ts=3380012000? label: keystore-egress-audit-gap, severity: P2.
maria: on it. opening ticket and will attach CloudTrail snippets + affected instance IDs.
ajay: follow-up: let's schedule a short maintenance to coordinate privatelink rotation with fw changes next week. i'll draft a checklist.
samir: thanks everyone. adding note to runbook and will close once audit backfill done and joins stable. :thumbsup:
